All numbers from the head-to-head comparison paper (N=468 Kalshi-comparable games, N=1,544 full Basketball IQ database). The 60% threshold is statistically significant (chi-square, p<0.001). Below-60% predictions perform at 56.8% — above random but below the ~62% needed to break even on standard -110 lines.
